content.title: Stellar Gear
content.body:
§lQuick Upgrades:
    - Dragon Slayer Weapons
    - Greater Equipment Forge
    - Tome of Arcana (Advanced)
    - Black Elytra
    - Black Dragon Scale
    - Shield of Honor: Requires the Dragon Egg
    §lImportant Ores:
    (Harvest Level 6 Required)
    - Ender Amethyst
    - Eximite
    - Meutoite
    §lThe Outer Islands
    - To access them, throw an Ender Pearl into one of the portals that generated in the edges of the main island
